facts.text: I am thinking of getting a screen protector for my new Samsung Galaxy S22.
I cracked my old phone's screen in January when I dropped it on the bathroom floor while getting ready for a job interview.
I am interested in the Zagg InvisibleShield Glass+ screen protector.
I am interested in the Samsung Official Screen Protector.
I want to compare the prices and availability of the Zagg InvisibleShield Glass+ and the Samsung Official Screen Protector.
I am deciding between a matte finish and a glossy finish screen protector.
I will go with the glossy finish for my screen protector.
I am not too concerned about fingerprints.
I like the way a glossy screen protector looks.
For the Zagg InvisibleShield Glass+, I am considering whether to get the regular version or the one with the "Anti-Glare" feature.
I will go with the regular Zagg InvisibleShield Glass+.
I do not use my phone outdoors that much.
I am getting a new phone mount for my car.
I will be using my phone in a more controlled environment because of the car phone mount.
I am good to go with the purchase.
I want recommendations for a good wireless charging pad for my new phone.
I have heard that some wireless charging pads can charge my phone faster than others.
